title: Orthognathic Surgery Masterclass 2026
subtitle: Predictability in Your Hands: From Digital Planning to Personalized Orthognathic Surgery
instructorBio: Prof. Valerio Ramieri is an internationally recognized leader in orthognathic and craniofacial surgery, with extensive experience in digital planning workflows and personalized surgical solutions.
description: An exclusive two-day program combining advanced digital planning, personalized surgical solutions, and hands-on cadaveric training.
overview: This exclusive masterclass brings together advanced digital planning methodology and personalized orthognathic surgical techniques in an intensive two-day cadaveric program. Under the direction of Prof. Valerio Ramieri, participants will work through the full workflow — from virtual surgical planning and patient-specific solution design through to hands-on cadaveric execution. The program is designed for oral and maxillofacial surgeons seeking to achieve greater predictability, precision, and consistency in their orthognathic practice. Seats are strictly limited to ensure individual attention and optimal lab time.

title: Orthognathic & PSI Course
subtitle: Advanced Patient-Specific Implant Planning and Surgical Execution
location: Mediclinic City Hospital, Dubai Healthcare City
description: A comprehensive three-day cadaveric training program combining digital planning workflows with live surgical simulation for orthognathic procedures and patient-specific implant placement.
overview: This intensive program bridges the gap between digital surgical planning and real-world operative execution. Participants worked with industry-leading planning software, patient-specific cutting guides, and titanium PSI implants on cadaveric specimens under expert supervision.

title: Digital Surgery Workflow
subtitle: From CBCT to Operating Room — End-to-End Digital Precision
description: A practical two-day workshop covering the complete digital surgery pipeline from imaging acquisition through 3D planning, guide fabrication, and intraoperative navigation.
overview: Surgeons gained hands-on experience with CBCT data processing, 3D planning software, and surgical guide design.

title: CMF Reconstruction Workshop
subtitle: Advanced Craniomaxillofacial Reconstruction Techniques
description: Three intensive days of cadaveric simulation focusing on advanced orbital, mandibular, and mid-face reconstruction using titanium mesh, custom implants, and modern fixation systems.
overview: This program addressed the most demanding cases in CMF practice — post-traumatic and oncologic reconstruction.

title: Advanced Implant Planning
subtitle: Precision-Guided Implant Placement for Complex Cases
description: An evidence-based workshop for clinicians seeking to master digital implant planning, guided surgery protocols, and immediate loading strategies for complex multi-unit restorations.
overview: Participants worked through advanced case scenarios using guided surgery software, fabricated surgical guides, and practised placement technique on high-fidelity phantom models.
